requirements.title: Provider descriptor + validation
requirements.description: The ProviderDescriptor message (registry proto) is implemented with validation: provider_id unique and group-qualified, NL description required (the classifier routes on it), endpoint present for ACTIVE providers, ResultMapping present for ACTIVE providers, scope defaults PROJECT, state in {ACTIVE, CAPABILITY_GAP}.

validation.notes: An ACTIVE descriptor missing endpoint or result_mapping is rejected.
A CAPABILITY_GAP descriptor with no endpoint but with intended_home is accepted.

requirements.title: Registry CRUD (Connect + CLI)
requirements.description: RegisterProvider (upsert), ListProviders (optional bucket/type/state filters), DeregisterProvider, exposed over Connect and as CLI `providers register|list|remove`. Registrations persist in postgres and survive restart.

validation.notes: RegisterProvider upserts by provider_id; created flag false on second register.
ListProviders returns persisted rows after a simulated restart; filters narrow correctly.

requirements.title: First provider registered via thin adapter
requirements.description: cli-health.commands is registered via a declarative descriptor whose ResultMapping maps cli-health's existing Search response onto the unified SearchHit. No change to cli-health.

validation.notes: Applying the cli-health.commands ResultMapping to a sample Search response yields well-formed SearchHits.
